chat.title: Chat with Jobhunter
chat.hint: Ask questions ("Which applications are older than 3 weeks?") or request changes ("also look at climate tech in Lisbon"). Changes are shown for confirmation first.

subscription.title: My Claude subscription
subscription.desc: Uses your own Claude Pro/Max plan through the official Claude Code login. Jobhunter never sees your credentials.

api_key.title: Anthropic API key
api_key.desc: Your own key from the Claude Console, stored in your OS keychain. Billed per token to your account.

compatible.title: Anthropic-compatible provider
compatible.desc: Another provider with an Anthropic-compatible API (for example Kimi or GLM): base URL plus your key for that provider.

openai_proxy.title: OpenAI via proxy (LiteLLM etc.)
openai_proxy.desc: An Anthropic-compatible proxy in front of other models. Experimental and unsupported: structured output and tools may not work.

claude.loginHelp: Sign in with Anthropic's official login. Run this command in a terminal, follow the browser login, then click "Check again":
claude.loginNote: The login stays in Claude Code's own credential store. Jobhunter only checks whether a login exists.
claude.baseUrlHint: The provider's Anthropic-compatible endpoint, as given in its documentation.
claude.keyHint: Stored in your OS keychain (or the encrypted secrets file in server mode). Never shown again.
claude.termsNote: Anthropic's terms limit how subscription logins may be used by third-party apps. See docs/CLAUDE_ACCOUNT.md and decide for yourself; you can switch to an API key at any time.

general.title: Language
general.applicationLanguageHint: Language of CVs, cover letters and form answers.

models.title: Models per task
models.hint: Pick a model for each tier, and optionally override single tasks.

budget.title: Budget
budget.hint: When the estimated monthly spend reaches the budget, scans, discovery and auto-drafting pause and you get a notification.
budget.subscriptionNote: With a subscription, costs shown are API-price estimates; your plan's usage limits apply. A budget still pauses non-essential tasks.

scan.title: Scanning
scan.enabledHint: Runs while the app is running; missed scans are caught up after sleep.
scan.thresholdHint: Jobs below this score stay off the board.
scan.autoShortlistHint: Empty = off. Shortlisted jobs get drafts prepared.
scan.etiquette: Polite scanning: robots.txt is respected, at most one request every {{seconds}} s and {{pages}} pages per site per day.

companies.title: Target companies
companies.name: Company name
companies.hint: Jobhunter detects Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Recruitee, Personio and Workday automatically; other careers pages are read with a small model.

discovery.hint: Claude suggests companies that fit your search profile. Each suggestion needs your approval.

sources.title: Job boards and feeds
sources.hint: RSS feeds, the Arbeitnow API, or any careers page. LinkedIn jobs come only from LinkedIn job-alert emails.
sources.name: Name

upload.title: Upload a CV
upload.formats: PDF or DOCX, up to 20 MB. Text is read on this machine.
upload.linkedin: This is a LinkedIn profile PDF export

review.intro: Check every item Jobhunter extracted. Confirm, edit or delete it. Only what you keep becomes part of your profile.

interview.intro: Claude asks short questions to fill gaps in your profile: results with numbers, responsibilities, tools, what you want next. One question at a time; skip anything. Nothing is saved until you confirm the summary.
interview.goalsPlaceholder: e.g. Head of Product in Zurich or remote
interview.summaryHint: These facts come only from your answers. Edit or untick anything before saving.
interview.noFacts: No new facts from this interview.
interview.answerPlaceholder: Type your answer, or use the microphone…

style.intro: Paste 3–10 texts you wrote yourself (old cover letters, emails). Jobhunter learns your tone so letters sound like you.
style.pasteHint: At least a few sentences. Remove anything private you don't want stored.
style.proposal: Suggested style rules ({{lang}}), learned from your edits

facts.hint: Facts are the only material Jobhunter may use in CVs, letters and form answers. Facts from your profile update when you edit the profile.
facts.addPlaceholder: e.g. Speaks Spanish at C1 level

preferences.title: Application preferences
preferences.hint: Used for common form questions. Leave empty if you prefer to answer per application.

onboarding.welcomeText: Jobhunter runs on your computer or server. It finds jobs, tracks your applications in Gmail and prepares tailored applications from facts you confirm. Your data stays with you.
onboarding.cvDone: Profile saved with {{count}} facts. You can upload another CV or continue.

voice.browserUnsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser.

empty.title: No jobs yet
empty.body: Add companies or job sources, then run a scan. New matches above your threshold appear in Found.

board.dragInstructions: To move a card, focus its handle and press space or enter, use the arrow keys to choose a column, then press space or enter again. Press escape to cancel.

search.hint: Separate entries with commas. Changes are saved when you leave a field.
search.chatTitle: Or tell Jobhunter what you're looking for
search.chatPlaceholder: e.g. Senior product roles in Zurich or remote, at least CHF 140k, no agencies

detail.drafting: Drafting CV, cover letter and answers…
detail.noPackage: No documents yet. Jobhunter drafts a tailored CV, cover letter and form answers from your confirmed facts.
detail.styleNote: Written in your style. Your edits teach Jobhunter your preferences.
detail.instruction: Instruction for the new version, e.g. shorter opening
detail.applyNote: The agent fills in the application form in its own browser and stops before submitting, unless you enabled automatic submission.
detail.noEmails: No emails yet. Replies from {{domains}} will be matched to this application.

docs.cvEditHint: One bullet per line. Employers, titles and dates come from your profile.
docs.gap: Not in your profile — answer this yourself

approvals.subtitle: Packages and prepared forms waiting for you.

harvard.name: Harvard
harvard.desc: Harvard Business School style: one page, serif, education first.

modern.name: Modern
modern.desc: Clean single column with one accent colour.

european.name: European
european.desc: Photo and personal details, common in CH and DE.

countryNote.CH: Photo, nationality and permit are common.
countryNote.FR: One to two pages; photo optional.
countryNote.UK: No photo or date of birth.
countryNote.US: One page, Letter paper, no photo.
countryNote.MX: Letter paper; never include CURP or marital status.

templates.photoHint: Only where it is customary. Never used for US or UK conventions.
templates.settingsHint: Change the template under Profile → CV templates, with a live preview.

email.reviewConfidenceHint: Below this, emails go to the review queue.
email.noResponseHint: Applications without any reply move to Closed.

connect.synced: {{processed}} job emails, {{changed}} status updates, {{review}} to review
connect.labelsHint: Adds labels such as Jobhunter/Rejected or Jobhunter/Interview. Nothing is deleted or sent.
connect.sampleSent: Use my sent emails for my writing style
connect.sampleSentHint: Reads up to 30 recent sent emails once, when you click the button below.
connect.intro: Jobhunter reads job-related emails to track your applications: confirmations, rejections, interview invitations, offers and job alerts. It never sends email.
connect.imapHint: Turn on 2-step verification, create an app password in your Google account, and paste it here. See docs/GMAIL_IMAP.md.
connect.appPasswordHint: 16 letters. Stored in your keychain. Not your Google password.
connect.gmailHint: Create your own Google Cloud project and a Desktop OAuth client (docs/GMAIL_OAUTH.md), then paste its ID and secret.
connect.finishInBrowser: Finish the sign-in in the browser tab that opened, then click "Check again".
connect.privacy: Email bodies are read on this machine and sent to your Claude model only for classification. Jobhunter stores the subject, a short snippet and a hash, never full bodies.

review.subtitle: Emails Jobhunter couldn't match with confidence. Your choice updates the application.

inbox.subtitle: Only job-related emails, grouped by application.

settings.title: Applying
settings.autoApproveHint: Skip your approval of CV and letter. Not recommended.
settings.responsibility: You are responsible for everything submitted in your name. The agent always stops at CAPTCHAs, logins, two-factor prompts, payment fields and unknown questions.

off.title: Off
off.desc: Jobhunter only prepares documents; you apply yourself.

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.desc: The agent fills in the form and stops before submitting. You review and submit.

submit.title: Submit automatically
submit.desc: Only when the match is high enough, the package is approved, the site isn't excluded, the daily limit isn't reached and nothing unexpected appears. Otherwise it prepares.

runs.title: Application form
runs.preparedHint: On desktop the filled form stays open in Jobhunter's browser window. In server mode, open the form on your device and use the answers from the package.

stop.login: Login required, Jobhunter never types passwords
stop.error_page: The page couldn't be loaded or the job is gone
stop.unknown_fields: Some required fields need your answer

login.title: Sign in
login.setupHint: This server has no password yet. Enter the setup code from the server log (docker compose logs jobhunter) and choose a password.
